# Ontology reference

<!-- Generated by `npm run docs:ontology` from ontology/schema.ts. Do not edit by hand; tests fail if this file drifts. -->

Terms follow Palantir Foundry: object types, link types, action types, functions, markings. Every record in the sample world is synthetic. Article numbers and bill numbers are invented.

Every object also has `id`, `type`, `markings`, `synthetic`, and may carry `provenance`. Real public records collected by `ingest/` are `Signal` and `Evidence` objects with provenance `public`, `synthetic: false` and the official https link; every other object, people and the whole company layer included, is synthetic.

## Roles

`system`, `agent`, `consultant`, `principal`

In the screens and in this reference, `principal` is the head of government affairs, `consultant` is an analyst on the government-affairs team, `agent` is the assistant and `system` is the collector.

## Markings

| Marking | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `PUBLIC` | Public legislative record. Visible to every caller. |
| `CLIENT:<clientId>` | One company's layer. Visible only to callers assigned to that company, and sent to a model provider only if it is allow-listed. |

## Object types

### `Issue`

Public layer. A policy topic that bills, events and signals are about.

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `summary` | text | yes |  |
| `keywords` | string[] | yes | Routes an item to an issue. How much the item matters to a company comes from the company's MonitoringProfile. |

Public layer. A bill before the National Assembly, with its stage history.

|---|---|---|---|

## Link types

Cardinality reads from source to target. `requiredFrom` / `requiredTo` list object types that must take part in at least one such link.

| Link | From | To | Cardinality | Layer | Evidence required | Required for | Properties |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `sponsors` | Person, Institution | Bill | one-to-many | public | yes | Bill (to) |  |
| `cosponsors` | Person | Bill | many-to-many | public | yes |  |  |
| `member_of` | Person | Institution | many-to-many | public | yes |  | role: enum(chair / secretary / member / official / staff); since: date; until: date |
| `referred_to` | Bill | Institution | many-to-one | public | yes |  |  |
| `amends` | Bill | Provision | many-to-many | public | yes |  |  |
| `about` | Bill, Event, Signal | Issue | many-to-many | public | yes | Bill (from) |  |
| `agenda_item` | Event | Bill | many-to-many | public | yes |  | purpose: enum(introduction / review / vote / wording / plenary) |
| `testifies_at` | Person, StakeholderOrg | Event | many-to-many | public | yes |  |  |
| `advises` | Person | Institution | many-to-many | public | yes |  | since: date |
| `coalition_with` | StakeholderOrg | StakeholderOrg | many-to-many | public | yes |  | issueId: ref -> Issue |
| `regulates` | Institution | Provision | many-to-many | public | yes |  |  |
| `mentions` | Signal | Bill, Person, Institution, StakeholderOrg | many-to-many | public | yes |  |  |
| `affects` | Issue | Client | many-to-many | client | no |  |  |
| `watches` | Engagement | Issue, Bill | many-to-many | client | no |  |  |
| `produced_for` | Deliverable | Engagement | many-to-one | client | no | Deliverable (from) |  |
| `derived_from` | Decision | Event, StakeholderAssessment, ClientPosition, ImpactAssessment | many-to-many | client | no |  |  |
| `raised_by` | Decision | Task, Deliverable, Signal | many-to-one | client | no | Decision (from) |  |

## Action types

Actions are the only way to change state. Each call is checked for role, parameters (every referenced object must be visible to the caller, and one call may name objects from at most one company layer) and preconditions, then executed or held for approval. Every attempt, including refusals, is appended to the audit log.

### `triageSignal`

File a new Signal for one company under an Issue and/or Bill with a relevance score, or set it aside for that company.

- Allowed roles: `agent`, `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Rule: Unless dismiss is true, issueId or billId is required.
- Rule: The company must not have filed or set aside this Signal already.
- Effect: Creates or updates the SignalTriage for this company and signal (CLIENT marking); the Signal itself is unchanged
- Effect: Creates about / mentions links, each with an Evidence record (method rule for agent, human for an analyst or the head of government affairs)
- Effect: Agent evidence below 0.8 confidence lands in the review queue

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | ref -> Client | yes |  |
| `signalId` | ref -> Signal | yes |  |
| `issueId` | ref -> Issue |  |  |
| `billId` | ref -> Bill |  |  |
| `mentionIds` | ref[] -> Person/Institution/StakeholderOrg |  |  |
| `relevance` | number [0..1] | yes |  |
| `confidence` | number [0..1] |  | Defaults to relevance. |
| `excerpt` | text |  |  |
| `dismiss` | boolean |  |  |
| `reason` | string |  |  |

### `linkEvidence`

Create a public-layer link (if absent) and attach one Evidence record to it. The collector files it for everyone; a company user files it for that company only.

- Allowed roles: `agent`, `consultant`, `principal`, `system`
- Approval: not required
- Rule: from and to must be object types the link type allows.
- Rule: Only the collector (system) writes PUBLIC links. Any other caller names clientId, and the link and its Evidence carry that company's marking, so one company's filing is never shown to another.
- Rule: Evidence.method is set from the caller role (agent or system = rule, human roles = human); callers cannot choose it.
- Effect: Creates the link and an Evidence record
- Effect: Agent evidence below 0.8 confidence: Evidence.reviewStatus = review

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `linkType` | enum(sponsors / cosponsors / member_of / referred_to / amends / about / agenda_item / testifies_at / advises / coalition_with / regulates / mentions) | yes |  |
| `from` | ref | yes |  |
| `to` | ref | yes |  |
| `clientId` | ref -> Client |  |  |
| `excerpt` | text | yes |  |
| `signalId` | ref -> Signal |  |  |
| `confidence` | number [0..1] | yes |  |

### `reopenSignal`

Undo a company's triage: return a filed or set-aside Signal to the company's queue.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Rule: The company must have filed or set aside this Signal.
- Effect: SignalTriage.status = returned
- Effect: Evidence that filing created is marked rejected
- Effect: Links left without other support are removed

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | ref -> Client | yes |  |
| `signalId` | ref -> Signal | yes |  |

### `reviewEvidence`

Accept or reject Evidence waiting in the review queue.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Precondition: `evidenceId`.reviewStatus in [review] (Evidence is not in the review queue)
- Effect: Evidence.reviewStatus updated
- Effect: Reject removes a link left without any non-rejected Evidence

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `evidenceId` | ref -> Evidence | yes |  |
| `verdict` | enum(accept / reject) | yes |  |

### `updateBillStage`

Record a stage change collected from the official bill tracker.

- Allowed roles: `system`
- Approval: not required
- Rule: Stage must move forward along the lifecycle (or to a terminal stage).
- Rule: A bill that is passed, merged_alternative or withdrawn cannot change stage.
- Rule: date must not precede the last history entry.
- Rule: merged_alternative requires mergedInto.
- Rule: Leaving legislative notice requires a billNo if the bill has none.
- Effect: Appends to Bill.stageHistory and updates Bill.stage

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `billId` | ref -> Bill | yes |  |
| `stage` | enum(public_comment / submitted / committee_referred / committee_review / subcommittee / subcommittee_passed / committee_passed / lj_review / plenary_pending / passed / merged_alternative / withdrawn) | yes |  |
| `date` | date | yes |  |
| `institutionId` | ref -> Institution |  |  |
| `mergedInto` | ref -> Bill |  |  |
| `billNo` | string |  | The number the Assembly assigns on submission. |
| `signalId` | ref -> Signal |  | The collected record the change was read from; kept on the history entry. |

### `submitForReview`

Move a draft into review.

- Allowed roles: `agent`, `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Precondition: `deliverableId`.status in [draft] (Only drafts can be submitted)
- Effect: Deliverable.status = in_review

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deliverableId` | ref -> Deliverable | yes |  |

### `redraftDeliverable`

Replace the text of a deliverable that has not been sent, for example when the weekly report is rebuilt from current data.

- Allowed roles: `agent`, `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Precondition: `deliverableId`.status in [draft, in_review, approved] (A sent deliverable cannot change)
- Effect: Deliverable.body and sourceIds replaced
- Effect: An approved deliverable goes back to in_review and its approval is cleared

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deliverableId` | ref -> Deliverable | yes |  |
| `body` | text | yes |  |
| `sourceIds` | ref[] |  |  |

- Allowed roles: `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Precondition: `deliverableId`.status in [in_review] (Only deliverables in review can be approved)
- Effect: Deliverable.status = approved, approvedBy recorded

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deliverableId` | ref -> Deliverable | yes |  |

Send an approved deliverable to company leadership (simulated; nothing leaves the browser).

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Precondition: `deliverableId`.status in [approved] (Blocked until the head of government affairs approves the deliverable)
- Effect: Deliverable.status = sent, sentAt set
- Effect: Audit entry carries the approver recorded on the deliverable

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `deliverableId` | ref -> Deliverable | yes |  |

- Allowed roles: `agent`, `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Effect: Creates a Decision (status open), a raised_by link and a derived_from link to each basis record

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | ref -> Client | yes |  |
| `question` | text | yes |  |
| `recommendation` | text | yes |  |
| `alternatives` | string[] | yes |  |
| `raisedById` | ref -> Task/Deliverable/Signal | yes |  |
| `basisIds` | ref[] -> Event/StakeholderAssessment/ClientPosition/ImpactAssessment |  | Linked with derived_from. |
| `premise` | json |  | The values the decision rests on when raised; a change makes it out of date. |
| `subjectId` | ref |  |  |
| `dueDate` | date |  |  |
| `followUp` | string |  |  |
| `targetId` | ref -> Person/StakeholderOrg |  |  |
| `premiseStance` | enum(supportive / neutral / opposed / unconfirmed) |  |  |

### `resolveDecision`

Record leadership's call: approve, choose an alternative, decline or withdraw.

- Allowed roles: `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Precondition: `decisionId`.status in [open] (Decision is already resolved)
- Effect: Decision.status = resolved
- Effect: approve creates a follow-up Task for a human, titled with the decision followUp, due in 3 days or by the decision due date, whichever is earlier

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `decisionId` | ref -> Decision | yes |  |
| `resolution` | enum(approve / alternative / reject / withdraw) | yes |  |
| `note` | text |  |  |

### `createTask`

Create a dated follow-up.

- Allowed roles: `agent`, `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Effect: Creates a Task (status open)

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | ref -> Client | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `dueDate` | date | yes |  |
| `owner` | enum(human / agent / client) | yes |  |
| `subjectId` | ref |  |  |

### `completeTask`

Mark a task done.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Precondition: `taskId`.status in [open] (Task is already done)
- Effect: Task.status = done

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `taskId` | ref -> Task | yes |  |

### `assessImpact`

Rate how strongly an issue touches the company, with reasons.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: required from `principal` before it runs
- Effect: Creates or replaces the ImpactAssessment (CLIENT marking)
- Effect: Analyst ratings wait for approval by the head of government affairs

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | ref -> Client | yes |  |
| `issueId` | ref -> Issue | yes |  |
| `level` | enum(high / medium / low) | yes |  |
| `rationale` | text | yes |  |

### `assessStakeholder`

Record the company's read of a person or organization on an issue: stance, influence, relevance and what the stance rests on.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Rule: A stance other than unconfirmed needs at least one basis record.
- Rule: Humans only: the agent may not judge a person.
- Effect: Creates or replaces the StakeholderAssessment for this company, subject and issue (CLIENT marking)

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | ref -> Client | yes |  |
| `subjectId` | ref -> Person/StakeholderOrg | yes |  |
| `issueId` | ref -> Issue | yes |  |
| `stance` | enum(supportive / neutral / opposed / unconfirmed) | yes |  |
| `influence` | enum(high / medium / low) | yes |  |
| `relevance` | enum(high / medium / low) | yes |  |
| `basisIds` | ref[] -> Bill/Event/Signal/Interaction |  |  |
| `interests` | text |  |  |

### `addRiskOpportunity`

Add a risk or an opportunity to the company view.

- Allowed roles: `agent`, `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: required from `principal` before it runs
- Rule: subjectIds must name at least one bill, issue or event.
- Effect: Creates a RiskOpportunity (CLIENT marking)
- Effect: Agent and analyst additions wait for approval by the head of government affairs

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | ref -> Client | yes |  |
| `kind` | enum(risk / opportunity) | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `summary` | text | yes |  |
| `impact` | enum(high / medium) | yes |  |
| `urgency` | enum(imminent / in_progress / ongoing) | yes |  |
| `dueDate` | date |  |  |
| `subjectIds` | ref[] -> Bill/Issue/Event | yes |  |

### `updateStrategy`

Create or revise the strategy for one issue.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: required from `principal` before it runs
- Rule: A new strategy needs desiredOutcome and messages.
- Rule: Targets must be assessments on the same issue.
- Effect: Creates or updates the Strategy for this company and issue (CLIENT marking)
- Effect: Analyst changes wait for approval by the head of government affairs

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | ref -> Client | yes |  |
| `issueId` | ref -> Issue | yes |  |
| `desiredOutcome` | text |  |  |
| `messages` | string[] |  |  |
| `targetIds` | ref[] -> StakeholderAssessment |  |  |
| `allyIds` | ref[] -> StakeholderOrg |  |  |
| `planTaskIds` | ref[] -> Task |  |  |

### `updateMonitoringProfile`

Create or revise the company's monitoring profile: objectives, keywords, committees, agencies and source types.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: required from `principal` before it runs
- Rule: Objectives need text and priority 1-3; keywords need a term and priority high, medium or low.
- Rule: committees must be committees or subcommittees; agencies must be ministries or agencies.
- Rule: sources must be known source types.
- Rule: A new profile needs objectives and keywords.
- Effect: Creates or updates the MonitoringProfile for this company (CLIENT marking)
- Effect: Analyst changes wait for approval by the head of government affairs

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | ref -> Client | yes |  |
| `objectives` | json |  |  |
| `keywords` | json |  |  |
| `committees` | ref[] -> Institution |  |  |
| `agencies` | ref[] -> Institution |  |  |
| `sources` | string[] |  |  |

### `startPilot`

Start a trial: fix the window and record every item in it that hits the company profile.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Rule: The company needs a monitoring profile and no other open trial.
- Rule: from must not be after to, and to must not be after the base date.
- Effect: Creates a PilotEvaluation (status open, CLIENT marking) with the caught items

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `clientId` | ref -> Client | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `from` | date | yes |  |
| `to` | date | yes |  |
| `criteria` | json |  |  |

### `setPilotCriteria`

Change the pass criteria of an open trial.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Precondition: `pilotId`.status in [open] (The trial is closed)
- Effect: PilotEvaluation.criteria updated

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pilotId` | ref -> PilotEvaluation | yes |  |
| `access` | number [0..1] |  |  |
| `officialMisses` | number [0..undefined] |  |  |
| `noise` | number [0..1] |  |  |

### `addExpectedItem`

Add an item the team says the system must catch.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Precondition: `pilotId`.status in [open] (The trial is closed)
- Rule: date must fall inside the trial window.
- Effect: Appends to PilotEvaluation.expected

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pilotId` | ref -> PilotEvaluation | yes |  |
| `title` | string | yes |  |
| `url` | string |  |  |
| `date` | date | yes | Publication date. |
| `sourceType` | enum(bill_update / press_release / public_notice / news / minutes / seminar / ministry_press / gazette) | yes |  |

### `markRelevance`

Record the team's call on a caught item: relevant or irrelevant.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Precondition: `pilotId`.status in [open] (The trial is closed)
- Rule: signalId must be one of the caught items.
- Effect: Sets the relevance of that caught item

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pilotId` | ref -> PilotEvaluation | yes |  |
| `signalId` | ref -> Signal | yes |  |
| `relevance` | enum(relevant / irrelevant) | yes |  |

### `closePilot`

Close a trial and record pass or fail against its criteria.

- Allowed roles: `consultant`, `principal`
- Approval: not required
- Precondition: `pilotId`.status in [open] (The trial is already closed)
- Effect: PilotEvaluation.status = closed, result = pass or fail from pilotMetrics

| Property | Type | Required | Note |
|---|---|---|---|
| `pilotId` | ref -> PilotEvaluation | yes |  |

## Functions

Deterministic and read-only. Each takes a `view`, the caller-filtered read handle from `store.as(ctx)`.

| Function | Signature | What it returns |
|---|---|---|
| `whatChanged` | `whatChanged(view, since, until?)` | Stage changes, new signals, events held and upcoming, and risk movements after the since date. |
| `billRiskScore` | `billRiskScore(view, billId, clientId, asOf?)` | Weighted 0-100 score for one bill and one company, returned with every component. |
| `responseLevel` | `responseLevel(view, billId, clientId, since?)` | One of act_now, engage, monitor or watch for one bill and one company, from explicit rules (stage moved this week, next meeting or closing notice period within 7 or 30 days, company stance, issue impact), with the reasons that raise the level and those that keep it from going higher. An opposed, high-impact bill on an agenda within 7 days is act_now even if it did not move. |
| `keyPeople` | `keyPeople(view, billId, limit?)` | Ranked people around a bill, each with the reasons for the rank. |
| `upcomingDeadlines` | `upcomingDeadlines(view, clientId, days?)` | Open tasks and scheduled events for the company in the next N days. |
| `issueExposure` | `issueExposure(view, clientId)` | Issues ranked by how much active legislative risk sits on them for the company. |
| `stageGates` | `stageGates(view, billId)` | Who decides at each stage (bill review subcommittee, full committee, Legislation and Judiciary Committee, plenary): date, status, and the chairs and secretaries who control each agenda. |
| `profileMatch` | `profileMatch(profile, text)` | Which profile keywords hit a text (the term or a synonym, case-insensitive), which were suppressed by an exclude phrase, and a 0-1 score: hits combine as 1 - prod(1 - w) with w = 0.6 high, 0.45 medium, 0.3 low. |
| `pilotMetrics` | `pilotMetrics(view, pilotId, reach?)` | Trial results: sources reached (from the fetch results of a live collector run when supplied), missed items (and how many came from the Assembly or government), noise among judged items, median days from publication to detection, pass or fail on each criterion, and the same counts per source type. |
| `stakeholderNetwork` | `stakeholderNetwork(view, clientId, issueId)` | The company's assessed stakeholders on one issue and the public relations between them (cosponsorship, same committee, joint event), each edge with the records it rests on. |
